decisions.reason: The ID Vault was launched with a dedicated announcement and fits KOBIL's core identity offering, so its prospects are still uncertain and keeping it costs little.
The identity-bound wallet is only mentioned on the website and overlaps with Product D, but one year is too early to resolve its value and it builds on existing identity assets cheaply.
The NFC login authenticator is a niche add-on with only a mention, but as a low-cost option within the authentication portfolio it is worth holding until results show more.
The payment and wallet framework has its own page, which signals commitment and a promising market, so the option should stay open.
The multi-service app platform is close to KOBIL's strategic super-app direction, and its uncertain upside justifies keeping it at low marginal cost.
The application shielding library has its own page and extends the firm's established mobile security business, so dropping it is unlikely.
